verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is LangSmith Engine, a built-in feature that automatically detects recurring issues in traces, diagnoses their root cause and resolves them. That is a form of in-product delegated work, but it is scoped to trace issues and never described as a general assistant. Missing for 10: any documentation of a built-in AI assistant or chat agent that accepts user-delegated tasks, an explicit statement that Engine is AI-driven, the range of tasks Engine can take on, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Automatically detect recurring issues in your traces, diagnose their root cause, and resolve them with LangSmith Engine.
